verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs establish the data-oriented core: all engine and game logic runs on Bevy ECS, with components as plain Rust structs and systems as normal Rust functions. However, nothing in the pack documents a profiler, a job/task system, or instancing for heavy scenes. Only one of the story's several elements is evidenced. Missing for 10: profiler tooling, job/parallel task system, GPU instancing, scaling or performance evidence for heavy scenes, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can profile and scale — a real profiler, plus data-oriented paths (ECS, jobs, instancing) when scenes get heavy

citations.quote: All engine and game logic uses Bevy ECS, a custom Entity Component System
Components: Rust structs that implement the Component trait
